name: Sneg s krovyu
source:
Such a colorful world, built upon countless corpses.
So bright and beautiful, with a shell that holds flesh and blood within.
So joyful and kind, a world that changes people.
Yet it offers only two paths: Death or Life.
No right to make mistakes. No right to ponder. No right to freedom.
Only a Pitiful Defeat or a Colorful Victory.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3460497659]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如此多彩的世界，是建立在无数尸体之上的。
如此明亮美丽，外壳内有血肉。
如此快乐和善良，一个改变人们的世界。
然而它只提供两条路：死或生。
没有犯错误的权利。没有思考的权利。没有自由的权利。
要么是惨败，要么是多彩的胜利。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3460497659]Steam[/url]]
